title: Once the Coldpass/pilgrim-stair condition unlocks, add it directly to the 'travel to a known place' list, or give one landmark (e.g. Highward's gate, or the Oath-Ground once resolved) an explicit 'go to Coldpass' option instead of requiring undirected cardinal-direction wandering to find it.
